feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 20 September 2026 5:10am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 20 September 2026 at 5:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the Norwegian Sea and high pressure near the Azores extending a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 late morning, then 3 or 4 in the afternoon, backing west or southwest in the evening. Increasing 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, falling slight this afternoon.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then occasional rain or drizzle arriving late in the night or by tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in precipitation later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 Monday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle at first soon becoming fair late morning Monday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle at first.
